issues.title: Dangling Sibling References (Bundling Cap)
issues.why: The spec explicitly acknowledges (AC-SAG-29) that auditors with ~120KB caps cannot see sibling modules (02, 03, 04, etc.), yet it relies on them for normative logic.
issues.fix: Inline the 'Top 10' most critical rules from sibling modules into a 'Core Constraints' section in 00-overview.md.

issues.title: Missing Concrete Examples for App/WP Pattern
issues.why: While it provides a folder tree for the 'Features + Issues' pattern, it lacks a sample content snippet for a '01-backend.md' file within that specific context.
issues.fix: Add a 10-line markdown snippet showing the expected header and first section of a feature-level backend spec.

issues.title: Concurrency/Locking for Linter Scripts
issues.why: The spec mandates several linter scripts (AC-SAG-14) but does not specify behavior if multiple instances run (e.g., CI vs local) or how to handle partial file writes during 'self-heal'.
issues.fix: Add a requirement to 10-mandatory-linter-infrastructure.md stating scripts must use atomic writes for file updates.
